newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe to stop fixing public sector wages - paper.
newsitem.headline: Juppe to stop fixing public sector wages - paper.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe has decided to end fixing the framework for public sector wages and leave the negotiations to the public companies concerned, the Les Echos newspaper said.
At Juppe's office there was no immediate comment.

The paper said that for the first time in 14 years the Prime Minister would not send a letter to other ministers informing them of a limit to wage increases in the public companies reporting to their ministry.

The paper said that public sector unions always tried to get the maximum indicated by the ceiling rate and the new system would allow more differentiated talks depending on the financial situation of the company concerned.
The framework letters were introduced in 1983 and replaced an automatic indexation of wages.
